messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert - Tenant-specific quality degradation detected for tenant 'acme-enterprises' on dedicated pool dp-eu-9. Metric: eval_fail_rate jumped +12.6% vs baseline. Triggered 2026-03-16T07:42:57Z.

oncall-lucas: Ack. Paging SRE rotation. Theo, you're up for triage? Any infra/ops signals?
theo: On it. infra-bot shows GPUs healthy, no OOMs, latencies stable. This smells like a model-level regression.
priya: FYI I promoted quant profile q-opt-v7 to canary at 07:30, and it auto-promoted to pool after criteria flagged green. Canary selection was synthetic prompts only (mistake).
cs-omar: Customer (acme-enterprises) just DM'd support. They say summaries are inventing product names and legal references. Their CI smoke fails for 100% of nightly runs. They're asking for immediate isolation.
acme-eng: We saw it spike in our integration run at 07:39. We can toggle to previous variant if you can instruct. We need a rollback and a short summary for our execs.

theo: Containment options: 1) Tenant safe-mode toggle to opt-out of new quant (route to last-good variant). 2) Emergency rollback of q-opt-v7 from dp-eu-9. 3) Shadow routing to a verified backup pool dp-eu-2 while we validate. Recommend doing 1 and 2 immediately.
oncall-lucas: Agreed. Priya, can you execute the rollback and also push the tenant-safe toggle? I'll coordinate customer comms.

priya: Running commands now:
```
# toggle tenant safe-mode
redwoodctl tenant set-flag acme-enterprises --flag disable_auto_quant=true --reason "emergency: quality regression"

# pin tenant to previous model variant
redwoodctl tenant route acme-enterprises --model v4.6-stable --force "emergency route: revert to last good model"

# rollback quant profile on pool
redwoodctl rollout revert --pool dp-eu-9 --from rlt-202603160730 --to-profile q-stable-v5
```

incident-bot: Tenant flag set: disable_auto_quant=true for acme-enterprises. Routing change observed: acme-enterprises -> v4.6-stable (effective ~90%). Rollback job rbk-3061117793 queued.

infra-bot: Rollback rbk-3061117793 started on dp-eu-9. ETA ~90s.

acme-eng: Toggling observed, some requests still hitting new variant (~10%). We'll drain and re-run tests.

incident-bot: Rollback completed. dp-eu-9 now running q-stable-v5. Runtime confirms quant params back to prior values.

priya: Running quick verification eval against acme canonical set on dp-eu-9 (post-rollback).

theo: I'll run a parallel check against dp-eu-2 backup pool to compare outputs.

priya: Eval results: answer-fidelity back within -0.7% of baseline; hallucination counts normalized.

theo: dp-eu-2 comparison looks consistent with stable outputs. Looks safe to keep tenant pinned for now.

cs-omar: Reporting to customer: "We've pinned you to the previously verified model variant and reverted the quant profile on your pool. Please re-run your integration suite and confirm."

acme-eng: Re-running now. Expect update in ~3m.

incident-bot: Customer smoke tests pass (acme-enterprises) — reports returned clean.

acme-eng: Confirmed. Nightly integration green now. Thanks. Please provide a short RCA and assurance this won't auto-apply again.

oncall-lucas: Immediate actions taken: tenant safe-mode enabled, tenant routed to v4.6-stable, rollback applied to dp-eu-9, auto-promotion paused for canaries. I'll draft a quick incident note for Acme and schedule a 15m sync.

priya: Follow-ups I'll own and file as tickets:
- Add real-traffic canaries and include representative tenant prompts (not just synthetic) before auto-promote.
- Change auto-promote criteria to require at least one production-tenant smoke pass when pool is dedicated/VPC.
- Add an internal CS notification when auto-promote touches a dedicated/VPC pool.
- Implement a tenant-level safe-mode toggle in the Console for CS to use without SRE.

Commands I'll use to block auto-promote until change lands:
```
redwoodctl config set rollout.auto_promote --scope dedicated_pools --value false --reason "post-incident hold"
```

theo: Root cause hypothesis: canary evaluation used only synthetic tests; scores were artificially favorable with q-opt-v7; mismatch between synthetic and real tenant prompts allowed bad profile to graduate. Collecting traces and canary logs 07:20-07:50 for deeper analysis.

oncall-lucas: Handoff: I'm primary for next 2 hours, Theo will monitor traces for RCA. Priya will own fixes and follow-ups. CS Omar will manage customer comms and the 15m sync.

cs-omar: Scheduled 15m customer sync in 20m. I'll include rollback timeline, actions taken, and next steps for governance. ACME asked for a postmortem within 24 hours.

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated -> monitoring. Priority remains P1 until postmortem published. Checklist: [tenant pinned, rollback complete, auto-promote paused, customer notified, RCA tracing captured].

acme-eng: Appreciate the quick response. We'll want a test plan for future canaries touching our dedicated pool.

priya: Noted. We'll propose an explicit opt-in for canary exposure on dedicated pools and a visible consent in Console for customers.

theo: Capturing logs and will post RCA draft in this thread when ready. Leaving extended watch for 3 hours.

noncall-lucas: Thanks team. Great rapid isolation and rollback. Keeping thread open until postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:"
